t001: The open Synaura × Syntaxium draft covers 13 modules and states what the evidence and implementation status support.
t004: Synaura helps identify what matters. Syntaxium helps make relationships explicit. This package brings together 13 modules for working with language, structure and adaptation of expression.

t051: Syntaxium describes how the parts of a message relate. A clear phrase carries the meaning, so the reader can omit the sign and still understand it.

t066: Typography, spacing, color, geometry, images, movement and sound can convey selected relationships. Treat links between form and perception as testable hypotheses.
t067: Adaptation takes readability, contrast, keyboards, screen readers, scripts, devices and reduced motion into account. Keep meaning accessible without relying on color, animation or glyphs alone.

t071: proposed path :: text → recognize signs → derive syntactic relationships → semantic representation → AST → graph or visual form where needed
t072: The exact AST format, grammar, Unicode normalization, spacing rules, error handling and agreement between parsers still need definition and testing. This package includes no verified parser implementation.
t076: The token cost of a symbol depends on the model, tokenizer and version. A count of UTF-8 bytes cannot establish it reliably. Measure costs before generalizing across models.
t077: For each experiment, record the model, tokenizer version, input text, counting method and result. Give human readability and accuracy at least as much weight as token savings.

t081: notice the task → name the differences → connect the evidence → offer options → check understanding → act within the request and authority → retain an observable record → revisit the map
t082: The cycle may end with an adequate answer, a pause or an unknown. It implies no background agent, telemetry, autonomous access or persistent memory.
t085: Begin a comparison with a question, a corpus and a criterion. To assess one change, keep other conditions constant where possible.
t086: Log the source, language, version, environment and limitations. Work with people requires clear consent and dedicated protection of their data. Keep their personal responses outside any open test corpus unless separately authorized.
t089: Possible criteria include preservation of meaning, clarity, structural integrity, accessibility, retrieval robustness and processing cost. Each criterion first needs a reproducible procedure and a suitable corpus.
t090: Thresholds and formulas from early drafts remain unvalidated. A value stays unknown until there is a test and a baseline.
t093: SUTI.world provides a public entry point and a place to apply the method. SUTIcore defines design principles and limits. Synaura supports navigation through meaning. Syntaxium structures notation. Visual adapters, the AST, the parser and the runtime each require a concrete, tested implementation to be connected.
